title: ficus manok
intro: Ficus manok, commonly known as the banyan fig, is a species of fig tree that belongs to the family Moraceae. This plant is revered for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Ficus manok are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-stress properties. Additionally, the plant's leaves have been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues.
